topic: Telangana wants startups to solve *7* pu
hook: Telangana wants startups to solve *7* public problems. Apply by Nov 30
hook_b: Got a startup idea? The state could become your *first customer*
tldr: Telangana Innovation Startup Challenge is open till Nov 30 for startups, innovators, researchers and colleges.

beats.what: Telangana opened the Telangana Innovation Startup Challenge (TISC) for seven public-sector problems.
beats.why: The state wants tech fixes for farms, food safety, land, roads, health and education.
beats.care: Startup, researcher or student team? Apply at tisc.telangana.gov.in before Nov 30.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: 💼 Opportunity. Who can apply: startups, individual innovators, researchers, industry players and academic institutions from India and abroad. Deadline: Nov 30, 2026, on tisc.telangana.gov.in. The lead challenge: solar pump or retrofit kits for deep borewells that are 30% cheaper, with theft-resistant panels and tamper-proof metering. Others: rapid food-adulteration test kits, AI kitchen-hygiene monitoring for hostels, satellite mapping of lake and land encroachments, vehicle cameras that map potholes, and monsoon-proof road repair materials. Selected teams showcase at the Invest Telangana Global Summit at Bharat Future City in December. Shortlisting dates are not announced yet. Fee: not mentioned.

cards.q: Which problem should startups crack first?

cards.why: Affordable solar pumps or retrofit kits for deep borewells, 30% cheaper, is the lead challenge.

insight: Winners can run pilots with government departments and may win procurement contracts.
watch: Shortlisting and final-round dates, which the state says will be announced shortly.
